description: Spain's minimum wage (SMI) from 1 January 2027 under Real Decreto 1013/2026: EUR 1,286 a month in 14 payments, EUR 18,004 a year, EUR 42.87 a day; net after 6.52% employee Social Security; no income tax thanks to the EUR 1,033.58 deduction of Real Decreto-ley 38/2026 (phased out at EUR 23,171.89).
